approved.en: Ukraine has resumed missile strikes on Russian oil refineries and a missile-maintenance base, using Storm Shadow missiles supplied by the United Kingdom, while Russian drones have attacked ships in the Black Sea near Romania, leaving seven crew members missing. Kyiv blames SpaceX for throttling Starlink terminals that support its drone operations, and Russia has detained a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kyiv legger skylden på SpaceX for å ha begrenset Starlink-terminalene som støtter deres droneoperasjoner, og Russland har fengslet en japansk journalist på spionasjebeskyldning. Konflikten forårsaket 75 767 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In a separate incident, the son of the Israeli ambassador was critically injured in a West Bank attack. Azerbaijan hosted a rare summit that brought together Israeli and Palestinian representatives with other regional leaders. Two container ships sank near the Strait of Hormuz amid heightened Iranian attacks linked to the Gaza conflict. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized in two Lebanese trucks have prompted Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation, while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel, a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack during a hike near the Lebanon border, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, leading the IDF chief to order a probe and authorities to consider restricting hikes. Students on the same hike fashioned tourniquets from belts and socks after the blast. Hezbollah announced compensation for Lebanese homeowners whose houses were destroyed and unveiled an aid plan for displaced civilians. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024.
approved.nb: Hezbollah-eksplosiver som ble beslaglagt i to libanesiske lastebiler har fått Libanons statsminister og sikkerhetsstyrker til å love en grundig etterforskning, mens israelsk artilleri og luftangrep fortsetter mot Hezbollah-posisjoner i sørlige Libanon, og forårsaker sivile tap. I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk under en fottur nær Libanongränsen, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som fikk IDF-sjefen til å beordre en undersøkelse og myndighetene til å vurdere restriksjoner på fotturer. Studenter på samme tur laget tourniquetter av belter og sokker etter eksplosjonen. Hezbollah kunngjorde erstatning til libanesiske huseiere hvis hus ble ødelagt og presenterte en hjelpsplan for fortrengte sivile. UCDP registrerte 4 335 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024.

approved.en: Houthi missiles struck Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, killing five officials, and also hit a Saudi airport. Iran has increased its air defenses while shipping LPG and jet fuel despite a US blockade, and has sunk two container ships near the Strait of Hormuz, expanding the threat to regional shipping. US officials are reportedly considering the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes, and Trump has ruled out using a nuclear bomb on Iran. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Houthi-missiler traff Jemens presidentpalass i Aden og drepte fem tjenestemenn, og rammet også en saudisk flyplass. Iran har styrket luftforsvaret mens landet frakter LPG og jetdrivstoff til tross for en amerikansk blokade, og har senket to containerskip ved Hormuzstredet, noe som øker trusselen mot regional skipsfart. Amerikanske tjenestemenn vurderer ifølge rapporter å bruke «the mother of all bombs» dersom kampene gjenopptas, og Trump har avvist å bruke en atomvåpen mot Iran. Konflikten registrerte 123 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Saudi Arabia reported the palace strike and said the attacks prompted it to postpone its flagship golf tournament and raise concerns about other events. Iran was accused by Saudi Arabia of encouraging the Houthi attacks on Riyadh. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian authorities have arrested the main suspect in the 2013 Baniyas massacres and sentenced two individuals to death for the 2025 coastal sectarian violence. Two Syrian pipelines were damaged in recent attacks on energy infrastructure, including a fire-causing hit on a gas export line in the northeast. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu disclosed a direct conversation with President Ahmed al-Sharaa following a 2025 strike in Damascus, which Syrian sources said involved U.S. and Arab mediation. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Syriske myndigheter har arrestert hovedmistenkte i Baniyas-massakrene i 2013 og dømt to personer til døden for den sekteriske volden langs kysten i 2025. To syriske rørledninger ble skadet i nylige angrep på energiinfrastruktur, inkludert et brannutløst treff på en gasseksportlinje i nordøst. Israels statsminister Netanyahu opplyste om en direkte samtale med president Ahmed al-Sharaa etter et angrep i Damaskus i 2025, som syriske kilder sa involverte amerikansk og arabisk mekling. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraq's parliament approved the al-Zaidi cabinet while a curfew was imposed overnight in Kirkuk south of Daquq. The Iraqi bank rejected Treasury allegations of sanctions and security forces uncovered a mobile counterfeit currency operation near the Iran border. Iraq is set to receive its first air-defence system within months and has prioritized completing air-defence capabilities, while Italy prepared to resume military training and intelligence cooperation with Kurdistan. Militias are adjusting to a new era, and a militia leader warned they would fight if Iran faced an existential threat, with relations with the US never returning to normal. 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: The RSF is under US pressure for a humanitarian truce as UN officials call for an immediate halt to drone strikes that are killing civilians across Sudan, including a market in Darfur where over 30 people died. The RSF also attacked a Red Crescent volunteer and a livestock market in Nyala, killing and injuring dozens of women and children, while the SAF blamed the RSF for a market bombing in Darfur. El Niño has contributed to a humanitarian crisis, killing hundreds of children. A Russian diplomat alleges that US weapons supplied to Ukraine have been found in RSF possession. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

RSF angrep også en Røde Halvmåne-frivillig og et husdyrmarked i Nyala, og drepte og såret dusinvis av kvinner og barn, mens SAF beskyldte RSF for en markedsbombing i Darfur. El Niño har bidratt til en humanitær krise, og drept hundrevis av barn. approved.en: Communal clashes continue across South Sudan, with SPLA-IO forces retaking Akobo after a dawn clash that left many dead and wounded, and SSPDF soldiers wounded in an assault on a Mundri West military outpost. In Unity State, fighting between SPLA-IO and government forces raised the death toll to 29, while SSPDF reported 40 deaths in Rumbek clashes, contradicting the ministry's figure of 71. A high court in Juba sentenced five officers to 24 years for raiding a general's home, and a pastor received death threats in a refugee camp. The lethal communal violence now far exceeds the 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Kommunale sammenstøt fortsetter over hele Sør-Sudan, med SPLA-IO-styrker som gjenerobrer Akobo etter en kamp ved daggry som etterlot mange døde og sårede, og SSPDF-soldater såret i et angrep på en militær utkikkspost i Mundri West. I Unity-staten førte kamper mellom SPLA-IO og regjeringsstyrker til at dødstallet steg til 29, mens SSPDF rapporterte 40 døde i sammenstøt i Rumbek, i motsetning til departementets tall på 71. En høyesterett i Juba dømte fem offiserer til 24 år for å ha plyndret en generals hjem, og en pastor mottok dødstrusler i en flyktningleir. Den dødelige kommunale volden overstiger nå langt de 2 kamprelaterte dødsfallene i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have taken a key town in Tigray that includes the regional airport and are advancing toward an Eritrean border town, while militia reports claim Eritrean forces suffered losses in the fighting. In Amhara, combat has left at least 183 dead, according to the UN, and the Ethiopian Red Cross condemned an attack that killed an ambulance driver in Benishangul-Gumuz. The United States is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate the conflict. Hospitals in Tigray have resumed operations as supplies arrive. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Amhara har kamper etterlatt minst 183 døde, ifølge FN, og Det etiopiske Røde Kors fordømte et angrep som drepte en ambulansefører i Benishangul-Gumuz. USA oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å de-eskalere konflikten. Sykehus i Tigray har gjenopptatt driften etter hvert som forsyninger ankommer. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces are securing the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have captured Buurhakaba after heavy fighting in the Bay region and opposition fighters seized a third town in just over a week. The Somali government is screening travelers after Kenya confirmed an imported Ebola case and is hosting regional talks in Egypt with Eritrea, Sudan and its own officials to coordinate security amid rising Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions. Defence ties with Pakistan are deepening as Somalia seeks JF-17 fighter jets and has arranged the release of four Pakistani sailors freed from pirates. A presidential election is scheduled for May 2027. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Fitgharan-styrkene sikrer korridoren mellom Mogadishu og Baidoa, mens Laftagareen-styrkene har erobret Buurhakaba etter harde kamper i Bay-regionen, og opposisjonskrigere har tatt en tredje by på litt over en uke. Den somaliske regjeringen screener reisende etter at Kenya bekreftet et importert ebolatilfelle, og den er vert for regionale samtaler i Egypt med Eritrea, Sudan og egne tjenestemenn for å koordinere sikkerheten midt i økende spenninger mellom Etiopia og Eritrea. Forsvarsbåndene med Pakistan utdypes ettersom Somalia søker JF‑17‑jagerfly og har ordnet løslatelsen av fire pakistanske sjømenn som ble frigjort fra pirater. Et presidentvalg er planlagt til mai 2027. Konflikten forårsaket 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Rival jihadist groups JNIM and IS-linked factions clashed in northwestern Nigeria and in Burkina Faso, where IS claimed over 400 JNIM fighters were killed. The United States added Nigeria to its blacklist for recruiting child soldiers, and Mali expanded its reserve force by 2,400 recruits, including 800 women. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Armed clashes have expanded from the Northwest and Southwest into Yaounde, Douala and Maroua as security forces confront Ambazonian separatists while separatist attacks continue in the Anglophone regions. The government has deployed the Rapid Intervention Battalion to the Lake Chad region and urged drones and joint border patrols to secure the Nigeria-Cameroon border. Femicide rates have risen sharply, prompting protests, demands for legal reform, and UNESCO involvement in prevention efforts. A teacher died two months after her wedding while her husband faces a murder charge, adding to public unrest. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Væpnede sammenstøt har utvidet seg fra Nordvest og Sørvest til Yaoundé, Douala og Maroua mens sikkerhetsstyrker konfronterer ambazoniske separatister, og separatistangrep fortsetter i de anglophones regionene. Regjeringen har sendt Rapid Intervention Battalion til Chad-sjø-regionen og oppfordret til droner og felles grensepatruljer for å sikre Nigeria-Kamerun-grensen. Antallet drap på kvinner har steget kraftig, noe som har ført til protester, krav om lovreform og UNESCO-involvering i forebyggingsarbeidet. En lærer døde to måneder etter bryllupet mens hennes ektemann står overfor tiltale for drap, noe som øker den offentlige uroen. Konflikten forårsaket 231 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
